lines.zh: 我拖着脚走，草被压出一道
lines.en: I drag my feet, pressing a line in the grass.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，方向却很直
lines.en: I walk slowly, but very straight.

lines.zh: 我的身体在走的时候低了一截
lines.en: My body drops lower as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走两步就歪一下，再继续。
lines.en: Every two steps I lurch, then go on.

lines.zh: 我的手在身侧摆，不太协调
lines.en: My hands swing at my sides, out of time.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，走得不稳
lines.en: I come out from behind the tree, unsteady.

lines.zh: 我的脚落下去，没有声音
lines.en: My feet land without sound.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地量着这条林道
lines.en: I measure this forest track step by step.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟着我，位置有点偏
lines.en: My shadow trails me, a little off.

lines.zh: 我走的时候有东西在滴
lines.en: Something drips from me as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的一只脚在身后拖着
lines.en: One of my feet drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我的身体在走路时轻轻响
lines.en: My body sounds faintly as I walk.

lines.zh: 我站着，脸上的东西不太对
lines.en: I stand, and my face is not right.
One of my hands moves on its own.

lines.zh: 死亡演出，我慢慢低下头。
lines.en: In my death scene, I lower my head slowly.
My body rises and falls slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西从我身上落下来
lines.en: Something falls off me.

lines.zh: 我低着头，看影子比我慢。
lines.en: Head down, I watch my shadow lag behind me.
There is little sound in the wood.
My head stays tilted.
My mouth moves, without sound.
I unfold my fingers one by one.

lines.zh: 我在等什么，自己也说不清
lines.en: I am waiting for something I cannot name.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上晃得很慢
lines.en: My shadow sways slowly on the ground.

lines.zh: 树冠里有东西在动，不是我。
lines.en: Something moves in the canopy, and it is not me.

lines.zh: 我把身体往前倾了一点
lines.en: I lean my body forward a little.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，角度不太对
lines.en: I turn my head, at the wrong angle.
You are nearer than I thought.
My eyes have not closed.
I raise a hand, and the fingers are wrong.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声乱了，我听着。
lines.en: Your footsteps have gone uneven; I am listening.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，里面没有舌头
lines.en: My mouth is open, and there is no tongue.
You stand very straight before me.
I slowly turn my body.

lines.zh: 我一步也没有动，只是看着
lines.en: I have not moved a step; I only look.

lines.zh: 我的脸在你眼里变了形
lines.en: My face warps in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我把手伸出来，掌心摊开
lines.en: I put out my hand, palm open.
My eyes stay open as I fall.

lines.zh: 我的下颚松了，合不回去。
lines.en: My jaw has come loose and will not close.
I smile again, and my face does not follow.

lines.zh: 你握紧了手里的东西，怕了。
lines.en: You grip your weapon tighter; you are afraid.
I keep watching your throat.
I am in no hurry to come over.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你面前慢慢弯
lines.en: My fingers curl slowly before you.
You came here to find me.
I turn my face away, then back.

lines.zh: 我塌下去一半，又支起来
lines.en: Half of me sags, then props up again.
My head falls the other way.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚拖在地上
lines.en: I step back, feet dragging.

lines.zh: 我的手指一根根不听话
lines.en: My fingers disobey one by one.
Half of me has collapsed.
I slowly prop myself up.
My movements have slowed a great deal.
Something drips from me again.
My head hangs.
I withdraw between two trees.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，我不需要
lines.en: I have no need of what you hold.
But I want to see your hands open.
You hold it very steadily.
My hand stops halfway.
Give it and I will step back.
I tilt my head slowly at it.
My fingers open and close.
I lean a little your way.

lines.zh: 这东西在空气里有味道
lines.en: This thing has a smell in the air.
I crouch down slowly.
You hit my shoulder, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我的身体往一边塌了一点
lines.en: My body sags to one side.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，树上的叶子响了
lines.en: We collide and the leaves above sound.

lines.zh: 我的手在你胸前滑下去
lines.en: My hand slides down your chest.
One touch and I withdraw.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你的手上变形
lines.en: My body deforms under your hand.
I step back, leaving crooked prints.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的头转了半圈
lines.en: We meet and my head turns half around.

lines.zh: 我的手臂在你肩上滑过
lines.en: My arm slides over your shoulder.
I hold a tree to steady myself.

lines.zh: 另一个从树后出来，也歪着
lines.en: Another comes from behind a tree, also crooked.

lines.zh: 我们面对面站着，头都对不上
lines.en: We face each other, heads mismatched.
Its hands are missing things too.

lines.zh: 死亡演出的两只，一起低头。
lines.en: Two in the death scene bow together.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，声音贴着耳朵
lines.en: It comes close, its sound at my ear.

lines.zh: 它转过头，脖子转得太远
lines.en: It turns its head, and the neck goes too far.

lines.zh: 我们的头靠在一起，角度错着
lines.en: Our heads rest together, at wrong angles.
It reaches up and touches my face.
We walk into the wood together.
It follows me, its steps also uneven.
I bend, very low.

lines.zh: 我的手指想抓住，抓不紧
lines.en: My fingers try and fail to grip.

lines.zh: 我把它捧起来，靠在胸口
lines.en: I lift it and hold it to my chest.
I set it back down.
I look at it a long while.
I bend down, and stay too long.

lines.zh: 我抓起来的时候，手指漏了
lines.en: When I grasp it, my fingers let it through.
I press it to my chest, very light.
I look down at it and say nothing.

lines.zh: 我倒下去的样子，是演给你看的。
lines.en: My fall is staged for you.
I stop, and my body goes straight.
My head is no longer crooked.
Dragging my feet, I shuffle toward you.

lines.zh: 我的手指一根根朝你张开。
lines.en: My fingers splay toward you one by one.
You take a step back; I do not stop.
I count your steps in my head.
I set my body straight.
My head aligns with you.
Both my hands are up.
I snap a dead branch and keep coming.
My breathing has changed.

lines.zh: 你身后是林子最密的地方
lines.en: Behind you is the thickest part of the wood.
My fingers drag along the ground.
I am in no hurry; you cannot get away.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就多一点
lines.en: Each step you give, I gain a little.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到了你脚下
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first.
I follow you along the forest track.
You go left; my head tilts left too.

lines.zh: 我的脚步不齐，可我不停
lines.en: My steps are uneven, but they never stop.

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后那道影子里
lines.en: I stay in the shadow behind you.
You look back, and I stop just in time.
I follow you, one foot dragging.
You go up the slope; I follow.
My body grows straighter.
You look back and I am in the tree shadow.
I say nothing the whole time.

lines.zh: 你从树边走，我直接过去
lines.en: You go around the tree; I go straight.
Five steps left, and I am counting.
You run, and I am not slow either.
My fingers stay spread.
You are ahead, and there is one path.
I do not shout; there is no point.
I drag forward step by step, closing the gap.
I snap a twig underfoot.
You stop; so do I.
My face stays pointed at you.
One of my hands comes down.
I lunge and my body pitches forward.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你肩上合上
lines.en: My fingers close on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一击之后自己也歪了
lines.en: After the blow I am crooked myself.
One hand comes down from above.
I lunge, head first.

lines.zh: 我的指节在你胳膊上收拢。
lines.en: My knuckles close on your arm.
One push, and you give ground.

lines.zh: 我的动作连不上，第二下慢了
lines.en: My motion breaks; the second is slow.

lines.zh: 你一挡，我的手就从侧面来
lines.en: You block, and my hand comes from the side.

lines.zh: 我的额头撞在你锁骨上。
lines.en: My forehead cracks against your collarbone.
I raise a foot and bring it down.
I press to you, and I am cold.
You pull back; I follow half a step.
I miss and my hand is behind you.
I look at you with no expression.
A patch of the track darkens first.
I walk slowly out of the dark.

lines.zh: 我的头先是低的，然后抬起来
lines.en: My head is low, then lifts.

lines.zh: 我的手在我走到一半时才抬
lines.en: My hand only rises halfway through.

lines.zh: 我站住了，位置刚好在路中间
lines.en: I stop, right in the middle of the path.
A wet trail is left on the ground.

lines.zh: 林道尽头先出现一个影子
lines.en: A shadow appears at the track's end first.

lines.zh: 我从树后面一步一步出来
lines.en: I come out from behind the trees, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的头抬起来，比刚才正
lines.en: My head lifts, straighter than before.
I stand in the middle of the path, still.

lines.zh: 我的手先垂着，然后抬起
lines.en: My hands hang, then rise.
A wet trail is left under me.
I slowly look your way.
I open my mouth, slowly.

lines.zh: 我朝前走了一步，又一步
lines.en: I take one step forward, then another.
The air cools around me.

lines.zh: 我停在你正好要经过的地方
lines.en: I stop exactly where you must pass.
My body has finally steadied.
I taste the air your way.
My head is no longer crooked.

lines.zh: 火一碰我，我身上冒起白气
lines.en: Fire touches me and I give off white vapour.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下，砸在草上
lines.en: I fall from above onto the grass.

lines.zh: 水把我泡散，我抓不住形状
lines.en: Water soaks me apart; I cannot hold a shape.
The blast peels back half of me.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，我低头看洞
lines.en: Something passes through me; I look at the hole.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我停住不动
lines.en: That force holds me still.

lines.zh: 我一点劲都没有，走两步停一停
lines.en: I have no strength; two steps and a pause.
Lightning makes me transparent.

lines.zh: 底下没有东西，我一边散一边落
lines.en: Nothing below; I scatter as I drop.
